The development of HFACS was prompted by increasing problems with human performance. The current state of NNSY requires the application of RC and HFAC methodologies in support of process improvement. When NNSY encounters mishaps, near miss

documented to communicate lessons learned and derive mitigating actions going forward. This is accomplished through Team Learning Sessions, with the expectation that the session be performed immediately following an incident and/or accident. NNSY is currently experiencing a challenge in solving problems and investigating incidents involving human error. The timeliness of the completion of TLS Reports has also presented a challenge. To address the concerns, NNSY requires Apollo Root Cause Analysis (ARCA) training supplemented by HFACS training. 1.2 Objective/Scope: The objective of this task is to purchase a 3-year (Base +2 option years) of Root Cause Analysis (RCA) training utilized in the Human Factor Analysis and Classification System (HFACS) training. The overall training will enhance organizational capability to investigate, analyze, and expose root causes including human influences in operational investigations of incidents and accidents to improve operational performance and safety. The training will help safety professionals reduce the accident rate through systematic, data-driven investigative strategies and objective evaluation of mitigation methods. The desired end state is to have participants be equipped with efficient and effective knowledge for i

TLS Administration personnel, which encompasses in-person and virtual communication to provide mentoring and support. This training will help the Administrators perform independent reviews of causal analysis through the lens of HFACS, when providing feedback on final reports. Materials submitted for analysis ignitable liquids include debris samples taken from a fire scene, clothing taken from suspects or victims, or any other solid sample where it is desired to determine whether or not there are ignitable liquids associated with it. Such samples are submitted to the Laboratory in sealed nylon bags. Diese Anforderung dient der langfristigen Zukunftsfähigkeit und Erweiterbarkeit der Investition. Eine spätere Steigerung der Produktionsleistung soll möglichst durch ein Upgrade des vorhandenen Systems und nicht durch einen vollständigen Maschinentausch erfolgen können.
